open Classical in
theorem aux_label (N : ℕ) (f : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∃ A : Fin N → ℕ, (∀ i j, i < j → f i < f j → A i < A j) ∧
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ A i) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ t : Finset (Fin N), A i = t.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f t) := by
  let S : Fin N → Finset (Finset (Fin N)) := fun i =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin N))).filter
      (fun t => i ∈ t ∧ (∀ j ∈ t, j ≤ i) ∧ StrictMonoOn f (t : Set (Fin N)))
  have hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨{i}, ?_⟩
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self i, fun j hj => (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hj).le, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp at ha hb
    subst ha; subst hb
    exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
  have hex : ∀ i, ∃ t ∈ S i, (S i).sup Finset.card = t.card :=
    fun i => Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (S i) (hne i) Finset.card
  refine ⟨fun i => (S i).sup Finset.card, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij hf
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := hex i
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ht
    obtain ⟨hit, hle, hmono⟩ := ht
    have hjt : j ∉ t := fun h => absurd (hle j h) (not_le.mpr hij)
    have hmem : insert j t ∈ S j := by
      simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hk with rfl | hk
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact (hle k hk).trans hij.le
      · intro a ha b hb hab
        simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe] at ha hb
        rcases ha with rfl | ha
        · rcases hb with rfl | hb
          · exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
          · have := lt_of_lt_of_le hab (hle b hb)
            exact absurd this (lt_asymm hij)
        · rcases hb with rfl | hb
          · rcases (hle a ha).lt_or_eq with h | h
            · have := hmono (Finset.mem_coe.mpr ha) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hit) h
              exact this.trans hf
            · subst h; exact hf
          · exact hmono (Finset.mem_coe.mpr ha) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hb) hab
    have h1 : (insert j t).card ≤ (S j).sup Finset.card := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) hmem
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hjt] at h1
    show (S i).sup Finset.card < (S j).sup Finset.card
    omega
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := hex i
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ht
    show 1 ≤ (S i).sup Finset.card
    rw [hc]
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨i, ht.1⟩
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := hex i
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ht
    exact ⟨t, hc, ht.2.2⟩

theorem erdos_szekeres_fin (m n : ℕ) (f : Fin (m * n + 1) → ℝ) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (∃ t : Finset (Fin (m * n + 1)), m < t.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f t) ∨
    (∃ t : Finset (Fin (m * n + 1)), n < t.card ∧ StrictAntiOn f t) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hA1, hAt⟩ := aux_label _ f
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hB1, hBt⟩ := aux_label _ (fun i => - f i)
  by_contra hcon
  rw [not_or] at hcon
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
  have hAm : ∀ i, A i ≤ m := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hm⟩ := hAt i
    by_contra h
    exact h1 ⟨t, by omega, hm⟩
  have hBn : ∀ i, B i ≤ n := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hm⟩ := hBt i
    by_contra h
    refine h2 ⟨t, by omega, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have := hm ha hb hab
    simpa using this
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => (A i, B i)) := by
    have key : ∀ i j, i < j → (A i, B i) ≠ (A j, B j) := by
      intro i j hij heq
      have hne : f i ≠ f j := fun h => absurd (hf h) hij.ne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · have := hA i j hij h
        have := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        simp at this; omega
      · have := hB i j hij (by simpa using h)
        have := congrArg Prod.snd heq
        simp at this; omega
    intro i j h
    by_contra hij
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h' | h'
    · exact key i j h' h
    · exact key j i h' h.symm
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (m * n + 1))))
    (t := (Finset.Icc 1 m ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 n)) (fun i => (A i, B i))
    (by
      intro i _
      simp only [Finset.coe_product, Set.mem_prod, Finset.coe_Icc, Set.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨hA1 i, hAm i⟩, hB1 i, hBn i⟩) (hinj.injOn)
  simp at hcard

end ErdosSzekeres

name: chapter28.sum_choose_deg_le_choose_card
statement:
theorem sum_choose_deg_le_choose_card
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hC4 : ∀ (a b c d : V), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d →
      ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) :
    ∑ v : V, (G.degree v).choose 2 ≤ (Fintype.card V).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ v : V, (G.degree v).choose 2 = #((G.neighborFinset v).powersetCard 2) := by
    intro v; rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  simp_rw [key]
  calc ∑ v : V, #((G.neighborFinset v).powersetCard 2)
      = #(Finset.univ.sigma (fun v => (G.neighborFinset v).powersetCard 2)) := by
          rw [Finset.card_sigma]
    _ ≤ #((Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard 2) := ?_
    _ = (Fintype.card V).choose 2 := by rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_univ]
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Sigma.snd
  · intro ⟨v, p⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.coe_sigma, Set.mem_sigma_iff, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨hx.2.1.trans (Finset.subset_univ _), hx.2.2⟩
  · intro ⟨v₁, p₁⟩ hx₁ ⟨v₂, p₂⟩ hx₂ (hfx : p₁ = p₂)
    subst hfx
    simp only [Finset.coe_sigma, Set.mem_sigma_iff, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hx₁ hx₂
    have hp₁ := hx₁.2
    have hp₂ := hx₂.2
    suffices v₁ = v₂ by subst this; rfl
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 hp₁.2
    have ha₁ : G.Adj v₁ a := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₁.1 (Finset.mem_insert_self a {b})
    have hb₁ : G.Adj v₁ b := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₁.1 (Finset.mem_insert.2 (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton_self b)))
    have ha₂ : G.Adj v₂ a := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₂.1 (Finset.mem_insert_self a {b})
    have hb₂ : G.Adj v₂ b := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₂.1 (Finset.mem_insert.2 (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton_self b)))
    have hv₁a : v₁ ≠ a := G.ne_of_adj ha₁
    have hv₁b : v₁ ≠ b := G.ne_of_adj hb₁
    have hv₂a : v₂ ≠ a := G.ne_of_adj ha₂
    have hv₂b : v₂ ≠ b := G.ne_of_adj hb₂
    exact hC4 v₁ a v₂ b hv₁a hne hv₁b (Ne.symm hv₂a) hab hv₂b
      ⟨ha₁, ha₂.symm, hb₂, hb₁.symm⟩

end chapter28

name: chapter28.c4_free_edge_bound
statement:
theorem c4_free_edge_bound
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hC4 : ∀ (a b c d : V), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d →
      ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : Fintype.card V = n) :
    G.edgeFinset.card ≤ ⌊(n : ℝ) / 4 * (1 + Real.sqrt (4 * n - 3))⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  set e := G.edgeFinset.card with he_def
  have hchoose := sum_choose_deg_le_choose_card G hC4
  suffices h : (e : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / 4 * (1 + Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3)) by
    exact Nat.le_floor h
  have hhand : ∑ v : V, G.degree v = 2 * e := handshaking
  have sum_sq_bound : ∑ v : V, ((G.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) + 2 * (e : ℝ) := by
    have h_real : (∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ) * ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) := by
      have h1 : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) = 2 * (k.choose 2 : ℝ) := by
        intro k; rw [Nat.cast_choose_two (K := ℝ)]; ring
      have hc : (∑ v : V, (G.degree v).choose 2 : ℝ) ≤ ((n.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (hn ▸ hchoose)
      calc ∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ) * ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)
          = ∑ v : V, 2 * ((G.degree v).choose 2 : ℝ) := by simp_rw [h1]
        _ = 2 * ∑ v : V, ((G.degree v).choose 2 : ℝ) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ 2 * ((n.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith
        _ = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) := by rw [← h1]
    have h_eq : ∀ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ) * ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1) =
        (G.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2 - (G.degree v : ℝ) := by intro v; ring
    simp_rw [h_eq] at h_real
    have h_sub : ∑ v : V, ((G.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2 - (G.degree v : ℝ)) =
        (∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2) - (∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [h_sub] at h_real
    have h5 : (∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ)) = 2 * (e : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hhand
    linarith
  have n_eq : Fintype.card V = n := hn
  have cauchy : (∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have h := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun v : V => (G.degree v : ℝ))
    rwa [Finset.card_univ] at h
  rw [n_eq] at cauchy
  have sum_deg_real : (∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ)) = 2 * (e : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hhand
  rw [sum_deg_real] at cauchy
  have key : 4 * (e : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((n : ℝ) - 1) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * (e : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (2 * (e : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 4 * (e : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h1] at cauchy
    calc 4 * (e : ℝ) ^ 2
        ≤ (n : ℝ) * ∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2 := cauchy
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) + 2 * (e : ℝ)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left sum_sq_bound (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
      _ = (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((n : ℝ) - 1) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * (e : ℝ) := by ring
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst hn0
    have hcard : Fintype.card V = 0 := hn
    have he0 : e = 0 := by
      rw [he_def]
      have h := SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_le_card_choose_two (G := G)
      rw [hcard] at h
      have : Nat.choose 0 2 = 0 := by decide
      rw [this] at h; omega
    simp [he0]
  have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0)
  suffices h4e : 4 * (e : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) by
    linarith [mul_comm ((n : ℝ) / 4) (1 + Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3)),
              show (n : ℝ) / 4 * (1 + Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3)) =
                ((n : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3)) / 4 by ring]
  by_cases h4e_le : 4 * (e : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ)
  · linarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3))]
  push Not at h4e_le
  rw [show 4 * (e : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) ↔
      4 * (e : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) by constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith]
  have h4n3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (n : ℝ) - 3 := by
    have : 1 ≤ n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
    linarith [show (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) from Nat.one_le_cast.mpr this]
  have hlhs_pos : 0 < 4 * (e : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hsq : (4 * (e : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (e : ℝ), sq_nonneg (n : ℝ),
               show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (e : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg e,
               show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg n]
  have hrhs_nn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) h4n3
  calc 4 * (e : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)
      ≤ |4 * (e : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)| := le_abs_self _
    _ = Real.sqrt ((4 * (e : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    _ = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) :=
        Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _) _
    _ = (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (4 * (n : ℝ) - 3) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt hn_pos)]

end chapter28

theorem not_isDiag_iff_exists {z : Sym2 α} : ¬ z.IsDiag ↔ ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ z = s(x, y) := by
  induction z with | _ x y =>
  rw [mk_isDiag_iff, not_iff_comm]
  push Not
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using h x y
  · aesop

  ext; rw [Sym2.toFinset, Sym2.toMultiset]; simp

  ext; simp

lemma card_toFinset_mk_of_ne {x y : α} (h : x ≠ y) : s(x, y).toFinset.card = 2 := by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_two]
  use x, y, h
  simp

  induction z; simp

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

variable {G : SimpleGraph α} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

lemma handshaking : ∑ v, G.degree v = 2 * #G.edgeFinset := by
  calc  ∑ v, G.degree v
    _ = ∑ v, #(G.incidenceFinset v)             := by simp [G.card_incidenceFinset_eq_degree]
    _ = ∑ v, #{e ∈ G.edgeFinset | v ∈ e}  := by simp [G.incidenceFinset_eq_filter]
    _ = ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, #{v | v ∈ e}  := Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow _
    _ = ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, 2             := Finset.sum_congr rfl (λ e he ↦ by
      obtain ⟨x, y, hne, rfl⟩ := Sym2.not_isDiag_iff_exists.mp
        (SimpleGraph.not_isDiag_of_mem_edgeSet _ (SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset.mp he))
      have : #{v | v ∈ s(x, y)} = (s(x, y) : Finset α).card := by
        congr 1; ext v; simp
      rw [this, Sym2.card_toFinset_mk_of_ne hne])
    _ = 2 * ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, 1         := (Finset.mul_sum G.edgeFinset (λ _ ↦ 1) 2).symm
    _ = 2 * #G.edgeFinset                 := by rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones G.edgeFinset]

theorem sum_choose_deg_le_choose_card
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hC4 : ∀ (a b c d : V), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d →
      ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) :
    ∑ v : V, (G.degree v).choose 2 ≤ (Fintype.card V).choose 2 := by
  have key : ∀ v : V, (G.degree v).choose 2 = #((G.neighborFinset v).powersetCard 2) := by
    intro v; rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  simp_rw [key]
  calc ∑ v : V, #((G.neighborFinset v).powersetCard 2)
      = #(Finset.univ.sigma (fun v => (G.neighborFinset v).powersetCard 2)) := by
          rw [Finset.card_sigma]
    _ ≤ #((Finset.univ : Finset V).powersetCard 2) := ?_
    _ = (Fintype.card V).choose 2 := by rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_univ]
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Sigma.snd
  · intro ⟨v, p⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.coe_sigma, Set.mem_sigma_iff, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨hx.2.1.trans (Finset.subset_univ _), hx.2.2⟩
  · intro ⟨v₁, p₁⟩ hx₁ ⟨v₂, p₂⟩ hx₂ (hfx : p₁ = p₂)
    subst hfx
    simp only [Finset.coe_sigma, Set.mem_sigma_iff, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hx₁ hx₂
    have hp₁ := hx₁.2
    have hp₂ := hx₂.2
    suffices v₁ = v₂ by subst this; rfl
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 hp₁.2
    have ha₁ : G.Adj v₁ a := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₁.1 (Finset.mem_insert_self a {b})
    have hb₁ : G.Adj v₁ b := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₁.1 (Finset.mem_insert.2 (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton_self b)))
    have ha₂ : G.Adj v₂ a := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₂.1 (Finset.mem_insert_self a {b})
    have hb₂ : G.Adj v₂ b := by
      rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; exact hp₂.1 (Finset.mem_insert.2 (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton_self b)))
    have hv₁a : v₁ ≠ a := G.ne_of_adj ha₁
    have hv₁b : v₁ ≠ b := G.ne_of_adj hb₁
    have hv₂a : v₂ ≠ a := G.ne_of_adj ha₂
    have hv₂b : v₂ ≠ b := G.ne_of_adj hb₂
    exact hC4 v₁ a v₂ b hv₁a hne hv₁b (Ne.symm hv₂a) hab hv₂b
      ⟨ha₁, ha₂.symm, hb₂, hb₁.symm⟩

name: chapter28.sum_divisor_count
statement:
theorem sum_divisor_count (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, n / i
proof:
:= by
  have key := Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow (· ∣ ·)
    (s := Finset.Icc 1 n) (t := Finset.Icc 1 n)
  suffices h1 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n,
      (Finset.bipartiteAbove (· ∣ ·) (Finset.Icc 1 n) i).card = n / i by
    suffices h2 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n,
        (Finset.bipartiteBelow (· ∣ ·) (Finset.Icc 1 n) j).card = (Nat.divisors j).card by
      rw [← Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, key, Finset.sum_congr rfl h2]
    · intro j hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
      have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
      congr 1
      simp only [Finset.bipartiteBelow]
      rw [← Nat.filter_dvd_eq_divisors hj0]
      ext d
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hd1, hdn⟩, hdj⟩
        exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdj), hdj⟩
      · rintro ⟨hd_lt, hdj⟩
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hdj⟩
        · by_contra h; push Not at h; interval_cases d; simp at hdj; exact hj0 hdj
        · exact le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdj) hj.2
  · intro i hi
    have hioc : Finset.Ioc 0 n = Finset.Icc 1 n := by
      ext x; simp [Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le]
    rw [show Finset.bipartiteAbove (· ∣ ·) (Finset.Icc 1 n) i =
        {j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n | i ∣ j} from rfl, ← hioc]
    exact Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div n i

theorem avg_divisor_count_le_harmonic (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℚ) ≤
    ↑n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 : ℚ) / ↑i
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_divisor_count n
  have : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℤ) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (n / i : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  calc (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℚ)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (↑(n / i) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ↑n / ↑i := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact Nat.cast_div_le
    _ = ↑n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, 1 / ↑i := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1; ext i; ring

statement:
theorem avg_divisor_count_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ↑n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 : ℚ) / ↑i - ↑n <
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_divisor_count n
  have hrw : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℚ) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (↑(n / i) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  rw [hrw, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsize : (Finset.Icc 1 n).card = n := by simp [Nat.card_Icc]
  suffices h_diff : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (↑n * (1 / ↑i) - ↑(n / i) : ℚ) < ↑n by
    have := Finset.sum_sub_distrib (s := Finset.Icc 1 n)
      (f := fun i => ↑n * (1 / (↑i : ℚ))) (g := fun i => (↑(n / i) : ℚ))
    linarith
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (↑n * (1 / ↑i) - ↑(n / i) : ℚ)
      < ∑ _i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 : ℚ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
        · intro i hi
          have hi1 : 1 ≤ i := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hi).1
          have hi_pos : (0 : ℚ) < ↑i := by positivity
          rw [mul_one_div, sub_le_iff_le_add, div_le_iff₀ hi_pos]
          have h1 := Nat.lt_div_mul_add (a := n) (by omega : 0 < i)
          have h2 : (↑n : ℚ) < ↑(n / i) * ↑i + ↑i := by exact_mod_cast h1
          linarith
        · exact ⟨1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_refl _, hn⟩, by simp [Nat.div_one]⟩
    _ = ↑n := by simp [hsize]

name: chapter28.KnDimension.erdos_szekeres_finset
statement:
theorem erdos_szekeres_finset {n m : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hcard : m * m < S.card) (hf : Set.InjOn f (↑S : Set (Fin n))) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, m < T.card ∧
      (StrictMonoOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨ StrictAntiOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hno
  have hno' : ∀ T ⊆ S, m < T.card → ¬ StrictMonoOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∧ ¬ StrictAntiOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) := by
    intro T hT hc
    exact not_or.mp (fun h => hno ⟨T, hT, hc, h⟩)
  have hA : ∀ i ∈ S, esA f S i ≤ m := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨T, hTS, -, hmono, -, hc⟩ := esA_exists f S i hi
    by_contra hlt
    exact (hno' T hTS (by omega)).1 hmono
  have hB : ∀ i ∈ S, esA (fun x => -f x) S i ≤ m := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨T, hTS, -, hmono, -, hc⟩ := esA_exists (fun x => -f x) S i hi
    by_contra hlt
    refine (hno' T hTS (by omega)).2 ?_
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have := hmono ha hb hab
    simp only [neg_lt_neg_iff] at this
    exact this
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i => (esA f S i, esA (fun x => -f x) S i)) (↑S : Set (Fin n)) := by
    have key : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i < j →
        (esA f S i, esA (fun x => -f x) S i) ≠ (esA f S j, esA (fun x => -f x) S j) := by
      intro i hi j hj hij heq
      have hne : f i ≠ f j := fun h => absurd (hf hi hj h) hij.ne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · have := esA_step f S i j hi hj hij h
        exact absurd (congrArg Prod.fst heq) this.ne
      · have := esA_step (fun x => -f x) S i j hi hj hij (by simpa using h)
        exact absurd (congrArg Prod.snd heq) this.ne
    intro i hi j hj h
    by_contra hij
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h' | h'
    · exact key i hi j hj h' h
    · exact key j hj i hi h' h.symm
  have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun i => (esA f S i, esA (fun x => -f x) S i))
    (s := S) (t := Finset.Icc 1 m ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 m) (by
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨esA_pos _ _ _ hi, hA i hi⟩, ⟨esA_pos _ _ _ hi, hB i hi⟩⟩) hinj
  simp at this
  omega

end KnDimension
end chapter28

open Classical

noncomputable def esA {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (S.powerset.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin n) => i ∈ T ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∧ ∀ j ∈ T, j ≤ i)).sup Finset.card

theorem esA_pos {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∈ S) :
    1 ≤ esA g S i := by
  have : ({i} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ S.powerset.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin n) => i ∈ T ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∧ ∀ j ∈ T, j ≤ i) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset, Finset.singleton_subset_iff, Finset.mem_singleton]
    refine ⟨hi, trivial, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
      subst ha; subst hb; exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
    · intro j hj; exact le_of_eq hj
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) this
  simpa [esA] using h

theorem esA_exists {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∈ S) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, i ∈ T ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∧ (∀ j ∈ T, j ≤ i) ∧ T.card = esA g S i := by
  have hne : (S.powerset.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin n) => i ∈ T ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∧ ∀ j ∈ T, j ≤ i)).Nonempty := by
    have : 1 ≤ esA g S i := esA_pos g S i hi
    by_contra hh
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hh
    unfold esA at this
    rw [hh] at this
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTe⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ hne Finset.card
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
  exact ⟨T, hT.1, hT.2.1, hT.2.2.1, hT.2.2.2, hTe.symm⟩

theorem esA_step {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : i ∈ S) (hj : j ∈ S) (hij : i < j) (hg : g i < g j) : esA g S i < esA g S j := by
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hiT, hmono, hle, hcard⟩ := esA_exists g S i hi
  have hjT : j ∉ T := fun h => absurd (hle j h) (not_le.mpr hij)
  have hxi : ∀ x ∈ T, g x ≤ g i := by
    intro x hx
    rcases (hle x hx).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact (hmono hx hiT h).le
    · rw [h]
  have hmem : insert j T ∈ S.powerset.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin n) => j ∈ T ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∧ ∀ k ∈ T, k ≤ j) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    refine ⟨Finset.insert_subset hj hTS, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      have hx' : x ∈ insert j T := by exact_mod_cast hx
      have hy' : y ∈ insert j T := by exact_mod_cast hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx' with h1 | h1 <;> rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy' with h2 | h2
      · rw [h1, h2] at hxy; exact absurd hxy (lt_irrefl _)
      · exfalso
        rw [h1] at hxy
        exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le hxy (hle y h2)) (not_lt.mpr hij.le)
      · rw [h2]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hxi x h1) hg
      · exact hmono h1 h2 hxy
    · intro k hk
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hk with h | hk
      · exact h.le
      · exact (hle k hk).trans hij.le
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) hmem
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hjT, hcard] at h
  exact h

name: chapter28.KnDimension.iterated_erdos_szekeres
statement:
theorem iterated_erdos_szekeres :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (fs : Fin p → (Fin n → ℝ)) (S : Finset (Fin n)),
    (∀ i, Set.InjOn (fs i) (↑S : Set (Fin n))) →
    2 ^ 2 ^ p < S.card →
    ∃ T ⊆ S, 2 < T.card ∧
      ∀ i : Fin p, StrictMonoOn (fs i) (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨
                    StrictAntiOn (fs i) (↑T : Set (Fin n))
proof:
| 0, _, _, S, _, hS => by
    simp only [Nat.pow_zero, pow_one] at hS
    exact ⟨S, Finset.Subset.refl S, hS, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | p + 1, _, fs, S, hfs, hS => by
    have harith : 2 ^ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ 2 ^ p) < S.card:= by
      have h : 2 ^ 2 ^ (p + 1) = 2 ^ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ 2 ^ p) := by
        rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, sq]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁S, hT₁card, hT₁mono⟩ :=
      erdos_szekeres_finset (fs 0) S harith (hfs 0)
    have hfs' : ∀ i : Fin p, Set.InjOn (fs i.succ) (↑T₁ : Set (Fin _)) :=
      fun i => (hfs i.succ).mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₁S)
    obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂T₁, hT₂card, hT₂mono⟩ :=
      iterated_erdos_szekeres p (fun i => fs i.succ) T₁ hfs' hT₁card
    refine ⟨T₂, hT₂T₁.trans hT₁S, hT₂card, ?_⟩
    intro ⟨i, hi⟩
    match i, hi with
    | 0, _ =>
      rcases hT₁mono with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (h.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₂T₁))
      · exact Or.inr (h.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₂T₁))
    | i + 1, hi =>
      exact hT₂mono ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

end KnDimension

open scoped Classical in
noncomputable def lisSet {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) : Finset (Finset (Fin n)) :=
  S.powerset.filter (fun t : Finset (Fin n) => a ∈ t ∧ (∀ x ∈ t, x ≤ a) ∧ StrictMonoOn f (↑t : Set (Fin n)))

noncomputable def lisAux {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (lisSet f S a).sup Finset.card

theorem mem_lisSet {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) (t : Finset (Fin n)) :
    t ∈ lisSet f S a ↔ t ⊆ S ∧ a ∈ t ∧ (∀ x ∈ t, x ≤ a) ∧ StrictMonoOn f (↑t : Set (Fin n)) := by
  classical
  unfold lisSet
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]

theorem single_mem_lisSet {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    ({a} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ lisSet f S a := by
  rw [mem_lisSet]
  refine ⟨Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ha, Finset.mem_singleton_self a, fun x hx => (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).le, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
  subst hx; subst hy; exact absurd hxy (lt_irrefl _)

theorem lisAux_lt {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n)
    (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) (hab : a < b) (hf : f a < f b) :
    lisAux f S a < lisAux f S b := by
  have hne : (lisSet f S a).Nonempty := ⟨{a}, single_mem_lisSet f S a ha⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hteq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ hne Finset.card
  obtain ⟨htS, hat, hle, hmono⟩ := (mem_lisSet f S a t).mp ht
  have hbt : b ∉ t := fun h => absurd (hle b h) (not_le.mpr hab)
  have hlis : lisAux f S a = t.card := hteq
  have h2 : (insert b t).card ≤ lisAux f S b := by
    unfold lisAux
    apply Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card)
    rw [mem_lisSet]
    refine ⟨Finset.insert_subset hb htS, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact (hle x hx).trans hab.le
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe] at hx hy
      have key : ∀ x ∈ t, f x ≤ f a := by
        intro x hx
        rcases (hle x hx).eq_or_lt with rfl | h
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact (hmono (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hat) h).le
      rcases hx with rfl | hx <;> rcases hy with rfl | hy
      · exact absurd hxy (lt_irrefl _)
      · exact absurd ((hle y hy).trans_lt hab) (not_lt.mpr hxy.le)
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (key x hx) hf
      · exact hmono (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hy) hxy
  rw [hlis]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbt] at h2
  omega

theorem lisAux_big {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) (m : ℕ)
    (h : m < lisAux f S a) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, m < T.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) := by
  unfold lisAux at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hm⟩ := Finset.lt_sup_iff.mp h
  obtain ⟨h1, _, _, h4⟩ := (mem_lisSet f S a t).mp ht
  exact ⟨t, h1, hm, h4⟩

theorem lisAux_pos {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    1 ≤ lisAux f S a := by
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) (single_mem_lisSet f S a ha)
  simpa [lisAux] using h

theorem erdos_szekeres_finset {n m : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hcard : m * m < S.card) (hf : Set.InjOn f (↑S : Set (Fin n))) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, m < T.card ∧
      (StrictMonoOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨ StrictAntiOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n))) := by
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_or] at hcon
  have hI : ∀ a, lisAux f S a ≤ m := by
    intro a
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hc, hm⟩ := lisAux_big f S a m (not_le.mp h)
    exact (hcon T hT hc).1 hm
  have hD : ∀ a, lisAux (fun i => -f i) S a ≤ m := by
    intro a
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hc, hm⟩ := lisAux_big (fun i => -f i) S a m (not_le.mp h)
    refine (hcon T hT hc).2 ?_
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have := hm hx hy hxy
    simpa using this
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun a => (lisAux f S a, lisAux (fun i => -f i) S a)) (↑S : Set (Fin n)) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hab
    by_contra hne
    have ha' := Finset.mem_coe.mp ha
    have hb' := Finset.mem_coe.mp hb
    have hfne : f a ≠ f b := fun h => hne (hf ha hb h)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hfne with h2 | h2
      · have := lisAux_lt f S a b ha' hb' h h2; omega
      · have := lisAux_lt (fun i => -f i) S a b ha' hb' h (by simpa using h2); omega
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hfne with h2 | h2
      · have := lisAux_lt (fun i => -f i) S b a hb' ha' h (by simpa using h2); omega
      · have := lisAux_lt f S b a hb' ha' h h2; omega
  have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ S, (lisAux f S a, lisAux (fun i => -f i) S a) ∈
      (Finset.Icc 1 m) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc 1 m) := by
    intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨⟨lisAux_pos f S a ha, hI a⟩, ⟨lisAux_pos _ S a ha, hD a⟩⟩
  have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
  simp at this
  omega

theorem kn_dimension_bound (p n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ^ 2 ^ p < n)

theorem es_aux {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∃ A : Fin n → ℕ, (∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ A x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x < y → g x < g y → A x < A y) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ T ⊆ S, T.card = A x ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n))) := by
  classical
  let F : Fin n → Finset (Finset (Fin n)) := fun x =>
    S.powerset.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ (∀ z ∈ T, z ≤ x) ∧ StrictMonoOn g (↑T : Set (Fin n)))
  have hne : ∀ x ∈ S, (F x).Nonempty := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨{x}, ?_⟩
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    refine ⟨by simpa using hx, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp at ha hb
    subst ha; subst hb; exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
  refine ⟨fun x => (F x).sup Finset.card, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have : ({x} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ F x := by
      simp only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
      refine ⟨by simpa using hx, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb hab
      simp at ha hb
      subst ha; subst hb; exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
    have := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) this
    simpa using this
  · intro x hx y hy hxy hg
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTe⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (F x) (hne x hx) Finset.card
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
    obtain ⟨hTS, hxT, hle, hmono⟩ := hT
    have hyT : y ∉ T := by
      intro h
      have := hle y h
      exact absurd hxy (not_lt.mpr this)
    have hin : insert y T ∈ F y := by
      simp only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
      refine ⟨Finset.insert_subset hy hTS, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with rfl | hz
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact (hle z hz).trans hxy.le
      · intro a ha b hb hab
        simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe] at ha hb
        rcases ha with rfl | ha <;> rcases hb with rfl | hb
        · exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
        · exact absurd ((hle b hb).trans_lt hxy) (not_lt.mpr hab.le)
        · have h1 : g a ≤ g x := by
            rcases (hle a ha).lt_or_eq with h | h
            · exact (hmono ha hxT h).le
            · rw [h]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hg
        · exact hmono ha hb hab
    have := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) hin
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hyT] at this
    show (F x).sup Finset.card < (F y).sup Finset.card
    rw [hTe]
    omega
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTe⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (F x) (hne x hx) Finset.card
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
    exact ⟨T, hT.1, hTe.symm, hT.2.2.2⟩

theorem erdos_szekeres_finset' {n m : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hcard : m * m < S.card) (hf : Set.InjOn f (↑S : Set (Fin n))) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, m < T.card ∧
      (StrictMonoOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨ StrictAntiOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n))) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, hA1, hAs, hAT⟩ := es_aux f S
  obtain ⟨B, hB1, hBs, hBT⟩ := es_aux (fun x => - f x) S
  by_cases h : ∀ x ∈ S, A x ≤ m ∧ B x ≤ m
  · exfalso
    have hmaps : ∀ x ∈ S, (A x, B x) ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 m ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 m) := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨hA1 x hx, (h x hx).1⟩, ⟨hB1 x hx, (h x hx).2⟩⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => (A x, B x)) (↑S : Set (Fin n)) := by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hxy
      by_contra hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (fun e => hne (hf hx hy e)) with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd hxy.1 (hAs x hx y hy hlt h1).ne
        · exact absurd hxy.2 (hBs x hx y hy hlt (neg_lt_neg h1)).ne
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (fun e => hne (hf hx hy e)) with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd hxy.2 (hBs y hy x hx hlt (neg_lt_neg h1)).ne.symm
        · exact absurd hxy.1 (hAs y hy x hx hlt h1).ne.symm
    have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    simp at this
    omega
  · have h' : ∃ x ∈ S, ¬ (A x ≤ m ∧ B x ≤ m) := by
      by_contra hc
      exact h (fun x hx => by by_contra hh; exact hc ⟨x, hx, hh⟩)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxm⟩ := h'
    by_cases hA : m < A x
    · obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTc, hTm⟩ := hAT x hx
      exact ⟨T, hTS, by omega, Or.inl hTm⟩
    · have hB : m < B x := by
        by_contra hb
        exact hxm ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTc, hTm⟩ := hBT x hx
      refine ⟨T, hTS, by omega, Or.inr ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb hab
      have := hTm ha hb hab
      exact neg_lt_neg_iff.mp this

theorem iterated_erdos_szekeres :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (fs : Fin p → (Fin n → ℝ)) (S : Finset (Fin n)),
    (∀ i, Set.InjOn (fs i) (↑S : Set (Fin n))) →
    2 ^ 2 ^ p < S.card →
    ∃ T ⊆ S, 2 < T.card ∧
      ∀ i : Fin p, StrictMonoOn (fs i) (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨
                    StrictAntiOn (fs i) (↑T : Set (Fin n))
  | 0, _, _, S, _, hS => by
    simp only [Nat.pow_zero, pow_one] at hS
    exact ⟨S, Finset.Subset.refl S, hS, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | p + 1, _, fs, S, hfs, hS => by
    have harith : 2 ^ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ 2 ^ p) < S.card := by
      have h : 2 ^ 2 ^ (p + 1) = 2 ^ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ 2 ^ p) := by
        rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, sq]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁S, hT₁card, hT₁mono⟩ :=
      erdos_szekeres_finset' (fs 0) S harith (hfs 0)
    have hfs' : ∀ i : Fin p, Set.InjOn (fs i.succ) (↑T₁ : Set (Fin _)) :=
      fun i => (hfs i.succ).mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₁S)
    obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂T₁, hT₂card, hT₂mono⟩ :=
      iterated_erdos_szekeres p (fun i => fs i.succ) T₁ hfs' hT₁card
    refine ⟨T₂, hT₂T₁.trans hT₁S, hT₂card, ?_⟩
    intro ⟨i, hi⟩
    match i, hi with
    | 0, _ =>
      rcases hT₁mono with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (h.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₂T₁))
      · exact Or.inr (h.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₂T₁))
    | i + 1, hi =>
      exact hT₂mono ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

theorem chain_exists {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) :
    ∃ c : Fin n → ℕ,
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ T ⊆ S, x ∈ T ∧ (∀ y ∈ T, y ≤ x) ∧
        (∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, a < b → r a b) ∧ T.card = c x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ T ⊆ S, x ∈ T → (∀ y ∈ T, y ≤ x) →
        (∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, a < b → r a b) → T.card ≤ c x) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x => (S.powerset.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ (∀ y ∈ T, y ≤ x) ∧
    ∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, a < b → r a b)).sup Finset.card, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hne : (S.powerset.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ (∀ y ∈ T, y ≤ x) ∧
        ∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, a < b → r a b)).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨{x}, ?_⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset, Finset.singleton_subset_iff,
        Finset.mem_singleton]
      refine ⟨hx, trivial, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y hy; rw [hy]
      · intro a ha b hb hab; rw [ha, hb] at hab; exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTe⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ hne Finset.card
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
    exact ⟨T, hT.1, hT.2.1, hT.2.2.1, hT.2.2.2, hTe.symm⟩
  · intro x hx T hT h1 h2 h3
    apply Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card)
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    exact ⟨hT, h1, h2, h3⟩

theorem chain_step {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (htr : ∀ a b c, r a b → r b c → r a c) (c : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hc : (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ T ⊆ S, x ∈ T ∧ (∀ y ∈ T, y ≤ x) ∧
        (∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, a < b → r a b) ∧ T.card = c x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ T ⊆ S, x ∈ T → (∀ y ∈ T, y ≤ x) →
        (∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, a < b → r a b) → T.card ≤ c x))
    (x y : Fin n) (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y) (hr : r x y) :
    c x + 1 ≤ c y := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hxT, hTle, hTch, hTc⟩ := hc.1 x hx
  have hyT : y ∉ T := fun h => absurd (hTle y h) (not_le.mpr hxy)
  have := hc.2 y hy (insert y T) (Finset.insert_subset hy hTS) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    (by
      intro z hz
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact (hTle z hz).trans hxy.le)
    (by
      intro a ha b hb hab
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hb with rfl | hb'
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ha with rfl | ha'
        · exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
        · rcases (hTle a ha').eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
          · exact hr
          · exact htr _ _ _ (hTch a ha' x hxT hlt) hr
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ha with rfl | ha'
        · exact absurd ((hTle b hb').trans_lt hxy) (not_lt.mpr hab.le)
        · exact hTch a ha' b hb' hab)
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hyT] at this
  omega

theorem erdos_szekeres_finset {n m : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hcard : m * m < S.card) (hf : Set.InjOn f (↑S : Set (Fin n))) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, m < T.card ∧
      (StrictMonoOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨ StrictAntiOn f (↑T : Set (Fin n))) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c1, h1⟩ := chain_exists S (fun a b => f a < f b)
  obtain ⟨c2, h2⟩ := chain_exists S (fun a b => f b < f a)
  have s1 := chain_step S (fun a b => f a < f b) (fun a b c => lt_trans) c1 h1
  have s2 := chain_step S (fun a b => f b < f a) (fun a b c h h' => lt_trans h' h) c2 h2
  by_cases hall : ∀ x ∈ S, c1 x ≤ m ∧ c2 x ≤ m
  · exfalso
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => (c1 x, c2 x)) (↑S : Set (Fin n)) := by
      have key : ∀ x y, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → x < y → (c1 x, c2 x) ≠ (c1 y, c2 y) := by
        intro x y hx hy hxy heq
        have e1 : c1 x = c1 y := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        have e2 : c2 x = c2 y := congrArg Prod.snd heq
        rcases lt_trichotomy (f x) (f y) with h | h | h
        · have := s1 x y hx hy hxy h; omega
        · exact absurd (hf hx hy h) (ne_of_lt hxy)
        · have := s2 x y hx hy hxy h; omega
      intro x hx y hy h
      by_contra hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h' | h'
      · exact key x y hx hy h' h
      · exact key y x hy hx h' h.symm
    have hmaps : ∀ x ∈ S, (fun x => (c1 x, c2 x)) x ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 m ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 m) := by
      intro x hx
      have a1 : 1 ≤ c1 x := by
        obtain ⟨T, _, hxT, _, _, hTc⟩ := h1.1 x hx
        have := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hxT⟩; omega
      have a2 : 1 ≤ c2 x := by
        obtain ⟨T, _, hxT, _, _, hTc⟩ := h2.1 x hx
        have := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hxT⟩; omega
      have := hall x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
      omega
    have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    simp at this
    omega
  · simp only [not_forall] at hall
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxm⟩ := hall
    by_cases hc : m < c1 x
    · obtain ⟨T, hTS, hxT, hTle, hTch, hTc⟩ := h1.1 x hx
      refine ⟨T, hTS, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb hab
      exact hTch a ha b hb hab
    · have hc2 : m < c2 x := by omega
      obtain ⟨T, hTS, hxT, hTle, hTch, hTc⟩ := h2.1 x hx
      refine ⟨T, hTS, by omega, Or.inr ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb hab
      exact hTch a ha b hb hab

theorem iterated_erdos_szekeres :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (fs : Fin p → (Fin n → ℝ)) (S : Finset (Fin n)),
    (∀ i, Set.InjOn (fs i) (↑S : Set (Fin n))) →
    2 ^ 2 ^ p < S.card →
    ∃ T ⊆ S, 2 < T.card ∧
      ∀ i : Fin p, StrictMonoOn (fs i) (↑T : Set (Fin n)) ∨
                    StrictAntiOn (fs i) (↑T : Set (Fin n))
  | 0, _, _, S, _, hS => by
    simp only [Nat.pow_zero, pow_one] at hS
    exact ⟨S, Finset.Subset.refl S, hS, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | p + 1, _, fs, S, hfs, hS => by
    have harith : 2 ^ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ 2 ^ p) < S.card := by
      have h : 2 ^ 2 ^ (p + 1) = 2 ^ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ 2 ^ p) := by
        rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, sq]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁S, hT₁card, hT₁mono⟩ :=
      erdos_szekeres_finset (fs 0) S harith (hfs 0)
    have hfs' : ∀ i : Fin p, Set.InjOn (fs i.succ) (↑T₁ : Set (Fin _)) :=
      fun i => (hfs i.succ).mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₁S)
    obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂T₁, hT₂card, hT₂mono⟩ :=
      iterated_erdos_szekeres p (fun i => fs i.succ) T₁ hfs' hT₁card
    refine ⟨T₂, hT₂T₁.trans hT₁S, hT₂card, ?_⟩
    intro ⟨i, hi⟩
    match i, hi with
    | 0, _ =>
      rcases hT₁mono with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (h.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₂T₁))
      · exact Or.inr (h.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hT₂T₁))
    | i + 1, hi =>
      exact hT₂mono ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

theorem kn_dimension_bound (p n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ^ 2 ^ p < n)
    (fs : Fin p → (Fin n → ℝ)) (hfs : ∀ i, Function.Injective (fs i)) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Fin n), 2 < T.card ∧
      ∀ i : Fin p, StrictMonoOn (fs i) ↑T ∨ StrictAntiOn (fs i) ↑T := by
  have huniv : 2 ^ 2 ^ p < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card := by
    simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; exact hn
  obtain ⟨T, _, hT_card, hT_mono⟩ := iterated_erdos_szekeres p fs Finset.univ
    (fun i => (hfs i).injOn) huniv
  exact ⟨T, hT_card, hT_mono⟩

private def nsq (z : ℂ) : ℝ := ‖z‖ ^ 2

    (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : 0 < rA f x := by
  simp only [rA, nsq]; exact pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hfp x hx).symm)) 2

private lemma rC_nonpos {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : rC f x ≤ 0 := by
  simp only [rC, nsq]
  have h := hfB x hx
  have h_sq : ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← one_mul (1 : ℝ)]
    exact mul_self_le_mul_self (norm_nonneg _) h
  linarith [h_sq]

private lemma rDisc_nonneg {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ rDisc f x := by
  simp only [rDisc]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (rB f x), (rA_pos hfp hx).le, rC_nonpos hfB hx]

private lemma quad_at_one (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
    rA f x + 2 * rB f x + rC f x = nsq x - 1 := by
  simp only [rA, rB, rC, nsq]
  have h : ‖f x + (x - f x)‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by congr 1; abel_nf
  rw [norm_add_sq_real] at h
  linarith

private lemma rS_root {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    rA f x * rS f x ^ 2 + 2 * rB f x * rS f x + rC f x = 0 := by
  have hA := rA_pos hfp hx
  have hΔ := rDisc_nonneg hfB hfp hx
  set B := rB f x; set C := rC f x; set A := rA f x
  set sqΔ := Real.sqrt (rDisc f x)
  have hΔeq : sqΔ ^ 2 = B ^ 2 - A * C := by
    simp only [sqΔ, rDisc]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hΔ
  have hS : rS f x = (-B + sqΔ) / A := rfl
  rw [hS]
  field_simp
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg sqΔ, hΔeq, sq_nonneg B, hA.le]

private lemma rR_norm_sq_expand (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
    nsq (rR f x) = rA f x * rS f x ^ 2 + 2 * rB f x * rS f x + rC f x + 1 := by
  simp only [rR, rA, rB, rC, nsq]
  set s := rS f x
  set a := f x
  set b := x - f x
  have hsm : (↑s : ℂ) • b = (s : ℝ) • b := Complex.coe_smul s b
  rw [show (↑s : ℂ) * b = (↑s : ℂ) • b from (smul_eq_mul ..).symm]
  rw [hsm, norm_add_sq_real a ((s : ℝ) • b), real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  ring

private lemma rR_on_sphere {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖rR f x‖ = 1 := by
  have h : nsq (rR f x) = 1 := by rw [rR_norm_sq_expand, rS_root hfB hfp hx]; ring
  simp only [nsq] at h
  have hnn := norm_nonneg (rR f x)
  nlinarith [sq_abs ‖rR f x‖]

private lemma rS_eq_one {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hx1 : ‖x‖ = 1) : rS f x = 1 := by
  have hA := rA_pos hfp hx
  have hC := rC_nonpos hfB hx
  have hquad : rA f x + 2 * rB f x + rC f x = 0 := by
    rw [quad_at_one]; simp [nsq, hx1]
  have hBval : rB f x = -(rA f x + rC f x) / 2 := by linarith
  have hDiscEq : rDisc f x = ((rA f x - rC f x) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [rDisc, hBval]; ring
  have hAC : 0 ≤ (rA f x - rC f x) / 2 := by linarith
  simp only [rS, hBval, hDiscEq, Real.sqrt_sq hAC]
  field_simp; ring

private lemma rR_eq_on_sphere {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hx1 : ‖x‖ = 1) : rR f x = x := by
  have h1 := rS_eq_one hfB hfp hx hx1
  simp only [rR, h1]; push_cast; ring

private lemma rR_continuousOn {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x) :
    ContinuousOn (rR f) (closedBall 0 1) := by
  have hfco : ContinuousOn f (closedBall 0 1) := hfc.continuousOn
  have hA_cont : ContinuousOn (rA f) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_id.sub hfco)).pow 2
  have hB_cont : ContinuousOn (rB f) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
    unfold rB
    have hfco' : ContinuousOn (fun x => (f x, x - f x)) (closedBall 0 1) :=
      fun x hx => ContinuousWithinAt.prodMk (hfco x hx) ((continuousOn_id.sub hfco) x hx)
    exact continuous_inner.comp_continuousOn hfco'
  have hC_cont : ContinuousOn (rC f) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    ((continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hfco).pow 2).sub continuousOn_const
  have hDisc_cont : ContinuousOn (rDisc f) (closedBall 0 1) := by
    unfold rDisc
    exact (hB_cont.pow 2).sub (hA_cont.mul hC_cont)
  have hSqrt_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (rDisc f x)) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hDisc_cont
  have hA_ne : ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, rA f x ≠ 0 := fun x hx =>
    ne_of_gt (rA_pos hfp (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp hx))
  have hS_cont : ContinuousOn (rS f) (closedBall 0 1) := by
    unfold rS
    exact (hB_cont.neg.add hSqrt_cont).div hA_cont hA_ne
  unfold rR
  exact hfco.add ((continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hS_cont).mul (continuousOn_id.sub hfco))

private theorem retraction_from_fp_free {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x) :
    ∃ (r : C(closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, sphere (0 : ℂ) 1)),
      ∀ (x : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1), r ⟨x.1, sphere_subset_closedBall x.2⟩ = x := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun x => ⟨rR f x.1, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr
    (rR_on_sphere hfB hfp (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp x.2))⟩,
    (rR_continuousOn hfc hfp).comp_continuous continuous_subtype_val (fun x => x.2) |>.subtype_mk _⟩,
    fun x => ?_⟩
  ext; exact congr_arg Subtype.val (by
    simp only [ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    congr 1; exact rR_eq_on_sphere hfB hfp
      (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp (sphere_subset_closedBall x.2))
      (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp x.2))

private theorem brouwer_complex
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) (hB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ f x = x := by
  by_contra h; push Not at h
  have hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x := fun x hx hfx => (h x hx hfx).elim
  exact no_retraction_complex (retraction_from_fp_free hf hB hfp)

theorem brouwer_fixed_point_2d_from_complex
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hf : Continuous f) (hB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ f x = x := by
  set e := Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr with he
  set g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => e.symm (f (e z)) with hg
  have hgc : Continuous g := e.symm.continuous.comp (hf.comp e.continuous)
  have hgB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g x‖ ≤ 1 := fun x hx => by
    simp only [hg]; rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    exact hB _ (by rwa [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map])
  obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := brouwer_complex g hgc hgB
  exact ⟨e z, by rwa [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map], by
    have := congr_arg e hz2; simp [hg] at this; exact this⟩

end BrouwerProof

  simp only [rA, rB, rC, nsq]
  have h : ‖f x + (x - f x)‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by congr 1; abel_nf
  rw [norm_add_sq_real] at h
  linarith

private lemma rS_root {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    rA f x * rS f x ^ 2 + 2 * rB f x * rS f x + rC f x = 0 := by
  have hA := rA_pos hfp hx
  have hΔ := rDisc_nonneg hfB hfp hx
  set B := rB f x; set C := rC f x; set A := rA f x
  set sqΔ := Real.sqrt (rDisc f x)
  have hΔeq : sqΔ ^ 2 = B ^ 2 - A * C := by
    simp only [sqΔ, rDisc]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hΔ
  have hS : rS f x = (-B + sqΔ) / A := rfl
  rw [hS]
  field_simp
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg sqΔ, hΔeq, sq_nonneg B, hA.le]

private lemma rR_norm_sq_expand (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
    nsq (rR f x) = rA f x * rS f x ^ 2 + 2 * rB f x * rS f x + rC f x + 1 := by
  simp only [rR, rA, rB, rC, nsq]
  set s := rS f x
  set a := f x
  set b := x - f x
  have hsm : (↑s : ℂ) • b = (s : ℝ) • b := Complex.coe_smul s b
  rw [show (↑s : ℂ) * b = (↑s : ℂ) • b from (smul_eq_mul ..).symm]
  rw [hsm, norm_add_sq_real a ((s : ℝ) • b), real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  ring

private lemma rR_on_sphere {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖rR f x‖ = 1 := by
  have h : nsq (rR f x) = 1 := by rw [rR_norm_sq_expand, rS_root hfB hfp hx]; ring
  simp only [nsq] at h
  have hnn := norm_nonneg (rR f x)
  nlinarith [sq_abs ‖rR f x‖]

private lemma rS_eq_one {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hx1 : ‖x‖ = 1) : rS f x = 1 := by
  have hA := rA_pos hfp hx
  have hC := rC_nonpos hfB hx
  have hquad : rA f x + 2 * rB f x + rC f x = 0 := by
    rw [quad_at_one]; simp [nsq, hx1]
  have hBval : rB f x = -(rA f x + rC f x) / 2 := by linarith
  have hDiscEq : rDisc f x = ((rA f x - rC f x) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [rDisc, hBval]; ring
  have hAC : 0 ≤ (rA f x - rC f x) / 2 := by linarith
  simp only [rS, hBval, hDiscEq, Real.sqrt_sq hAC]
  field_simp; ring

private lemma rR_eq_on_sphere {f : ℂ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hx1 : ‖x‖ = 1) : rR f x = x := by
  have h1 := rS_eq_one hfB hfp hx hx1
  simp only [rR, h1]; push_cast; ring

private lemma rR_continuousOn {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x) :
    ContinuousOn (rR f) (closedBall 0 1) := by
  have hfco : ContinuousOn f (closedBall 0 1) := hfc.continuousOn
  have hA_cont : ContinuousOn (rA f) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_id.sub hfco)).pow 2
  have hB_cont : ContinuousOn (rB f) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
    unfold rB
    have hfco' : ContinuousOn (fun x => (f x, x - f x)) (closedBall 0 1) :=
      fun x hx => ContinuousWithinAt.prodMk (hfco x hx) ((continuousOn_id.sub hfco) x hx)
    exact continuous_inner.comp_continuousOn hfco'
  have hC_cont : ContinuousOn (rC f) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    ((continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hfco).pow 2).sub continuousOn_const
  have hDisc_cont : ContinuousOn (rDisc f) (closedBall 0 1) := by
    unfold rDisc
    exact (hB_cont.pow 2).sub (hA_cont.mul hC_cont)
  have hSqrt_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (rDisc f x)) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hDisc_cont
  have hA_ne : ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, rA f x ≠ 0 := fun x hx =>
    ne_of_gt (rA_pos hfp (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp hx))
  have hS_cont : ContinuousOn (rS f) (closedBall 0 1) := by
    unfold rS
    exact (hB_cont.neg.add hSqrt_cont).div hA_cont hA_ne
  unfold rR
  exact hfco.add ((continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hS_cont).mul (continuousOn_id.sub hfco))

private theorem retraction_from_fp_free {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x) :
    ∃ (r : C(closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, sphere (0 : ℂ) 1)),
      ∀ (x : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1), r ⟨x.1, sphere_subset_closedBall x.2⟩ = x := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun x => ⟨rR f x.1, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr
    (rR_on_sphere hfB hfp (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp x.2))⟩,
    (rR_continuousOn hfc hfp).comp_continuous continuous_subtype_val (fun x => x.2) |>.subtype_mk _⟩,
    fun x => ?_⟩
  ext; exact congr_arg Subtype.val (by
    simp only [ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    congr 1; exact rR_eq_on_sphere hfB hfp
      (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp (sphere_subset_closedBall x.2))
      (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp x.2))

private theorem brouwer_complex
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) (hB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ f x = x := by
  by_contra h; push Not at h
  have hfp : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → f x ≠ x := fun x hx hfx => (h x hx hfx).elim
  exact no_retraction_complex (retraction_from_fp_free hf hB hfp)

theorem brouwer_fixed_point_2d_from_complex
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hf : Continuous f) (hB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ f x = x := by
  set e := Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr with he
  set g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => e.symm (f (e z)) with hg
  have hgc : Continuous g := e.symm.continuous.comp (hf.comp e.continuous)
  have hgB : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g x‖ ≤ 1 := fun x hx => by
    simp only [hg]; rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    exact hB _ (by rwa [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map])
  obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := brouwer_complex g hgc hgB
  exact ⟨e z, by rwa [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map], by
    have := congr_arg e hz2; simp [hg] at this; exact this⟩

end BrouwerProof

      Projectivization.mk_eq_mk_iff_crossProduct_eq_zero hw]
  have key := cross_cross_eq_smul_sub_smul' w u v
  rw [hxc, dotProduct_comm, hxa, zero_smul, zero_smul, sub_self] at key

name: chapter28.orthogonal_set_card
statement:
lemma orthogonal_set_card [Fintype (PG2 p)]
    (v : PG2 p) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : PG2 p => Projectivization.orthogonal v w)).card = p + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Projectivization.ind with | h u hu =>
  set φ : Module.Dual (ZMod p) (Fin 3 → ZMod p) :=
    dotProductEquiv (ZMod p) (Fin 3) u with hφ_def
  have hφ_apply : ∀ w, φ w = u ⬝ᵥ w := fun _ => rfl
  have hφ : φ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hu ((dotProductEquiv (ZMod p) (Fin 3)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  have : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) (Fin 3 → ZMod p) := inferInstance
  have hfr : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (LinearMap.ker φ) = 2 := by
    have h1 := Module.Dual.finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero hφ; simp at h1; omega
  have : Finite (ZMod p) := inferInstance
  have hcard : Nat.card (ℙ (ZMod p) (LinearMap.ker φ)) = p + 1 := by
    rw [Projectivization.card_of_finrank_two _ _ hfr, Nat.card_zmod]
  have hι_inj : Function.Injective (Projectivization.map (LinearMap.ker φ).subtype
    (Submodule.injective_subtype _)) := Projectivization.map_injective _ _
  have : Fintype (ℙ (ZMod p) (LinearMap.ker φ)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [show p + 1 = Finset.card (Finset.univ : Finset (ℙ (ZMod p) (LinearMap.ker φ))) from by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]; exact hcard.symm]
  symm
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun w _ => Projectivization.map (LinearMap.ker φ).subtype
    (Submodule.injective_subtype _) w)
  · intro w _
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    induction w using Projectivization.ind with | h k hk =>
    rw [Projectivization.map_mk, Projectivization.orthogonal_mk hu]
    have hk_mem := k.2; rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hφ_apply] at hk_mem
    show u ⬝ᵥ _ = 0; exact hk_mem
  · intro a _ b _ hab; exact hι_inj hab
  · intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hw
    induction w using Projectivization.ind with | h k hk =>
    rw [Projectivization.orthogonal_mk hu hk] at hw
    have hk_mem : k ∈ LinearMap.ker φ := by rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hφ_apply]; exact hw
    have hk_ne : (⟨k, hk_mem⟩ : LinearMap.ker φ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hk; exact congr_arg Subtype.val h
    exact ⟨Projectivization.mk _ ⟨k, hk_mem⟩ hk_ne, Finset.mem_univ _, by
      rw [Projectivization.map_mk]; rfl⟩

end ReimanGraph

name: chapter28.reimanGraph_degree_eq
statement:
lemma reimanGraph_degree_eq [Fintype (PG2 p)] [DecidableEq (PG2 p)]
    [DecidableRel (reimanGraph p).Adj] (v : PG2 p) :
    (reimanGraph p).degree v =
      if Projectivization.orthogonal v v then p else p + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.degree]
  have hN : (reimanGraph p).neighborFinset v =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun w => v ≠ w ∧ Projectivization.orthogonal v w) := by
    ext w; rw [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]; simp [reimanGraph]
  rw [hN]
  set S := Finset.univ.filter (fun w : PG2 p => Projectivization.orthogonal v w)
  have hS_card := orthogonal_set_card p v
  split_ifs with h
  · have hv_in : v ∈ S := by simp [S, h]
    have : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => v ≠ w ∧ Projectivization.orthogonal v w)) =
        S.erase v := by
      ext w; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase, S]
      tauto
    rw [this, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hv_in, hS_card]; omega
  · have : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => v ≠ w ∧ Projectivization.orthogonal v w)) = S := by
      ext w; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, S]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨_, hw⟩ => hw, fun hw => ⟨fun heq => h (heq ▸ hw), hw⟩⟩
    rw [this, hS_card]

end ReimanGraph

def exponents_le {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) : Set (Fin n →₀ ℕ) := {s | s.sum (fun _ k => k) ≤ d}

lemma exponents_le_finite (n d : ℕ) : (exponents_le (n := n) d).Finite := by
  refine (Set.finite_Iic (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (fun _ : Fin n => d))).subset ?_
  intro s hs
  intro i
  have h1 : s i ≤ s.sum (fun _ k => k) := by
    rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset s (Finset.subset_univ _) _ (by simp)]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => s i) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  simpa using h1.trans hs

  (exponents_le_finite n d).fintype

name: le_binom_sum
statement: lemma le_binom_sum (k n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : k^n ≤ (k + n - 1).choose n * Nat.factorial n
proof:
:= by
  have h_binom : Nat.choose (k + n - 1) n * Nat.factorial n =
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (k + n - 1 - i) := by
    rw [ mul_comm, ← Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose ];
    rw [ Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range ];
  exact h_binom ▸ le_trans ( by norm_num ) ( Finset.prod_le_prod' fun i hi =>
    show k + n - 1 - i ≥ k from Nat.le_sub_of_add_le
    ( by
      linarith [ Finset.mem_range.mp hi, Nat.sub_add_cancel
        ( show 1 ≤ k + n from by linarith [ NeZero.pos n ] ) ] ) )

name: chapter44.false_of_three_le_degree_real
statement:
theorem false_of_three_le_degree_real (hG : Friendship G) (hd : G.IsRegularOfDegree d)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ d) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hAH : (G.adjMatrix ℝ).IsHermitian := by
    ext i j; simp only [conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, adjMatrix_apply, G.adj_comm j i]
  let ev := hAH.eigenvalues
  let eb := hAH.eigenvectorBasis
  let n := Fintype.card V
  let J : Matrix V V ℝ := of fun (_ _ : V) => (1 : ℝ)
  have hcard : d + (n - 1) = d * d := Friendship.card_of_regular hG hd
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := Fintype.card_pos
  have hn_eq : (n : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) + 1 := by
    have : n + d = d * d + 1 := by omega
    have : (↑n + ↑d : ℝ) = ↑d * ↑d + 1 := by exact_mod_cast this
    nlinarith
  have hAsq : (G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 = ((d : ℝ) - 1) • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) + J := by
    have h := Friendship.adjMatrix_sq_of_regular (R := ℝ) hG hd
    ext i j
    have : ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2) i j = if i = j then (d : ℝ) else 1 := by
      rw [h]; simp [of_apply]
    simp only [this, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, of_apply, J]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have hJsq : J * J = (n : ℝ) • J := by
    show J * J = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) • J
    ext i j; simp [J, mul_apply, of_apply, sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, Matrix.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hsum0 : ∑ i : V, ev i = 0 := by
    have h1 := hAH.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id] at h1
    rw [trace_adjMatrix ℝ G] at h1; linarith
  have hpoly : ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) • 1) *
      ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2 • 1) = 0 := by
    have hJ : (G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) • 1 = J := by rw [hAsq]; abel
    have hJn : (G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2 • 1 = J - (n : ℝ) • 1 := by
      rw [hAsq, hn_eq]; ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.add_apply, of_apply, J]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [hJ, hJn, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, hJsq, mul_one, sub_self]
  have hev_sq : ∀ j : V, ev j ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) - 1 ∨ ev j ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro j
    have hv := hAH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j
    set v := (eb j).ofLp
    have hA2v : (G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 *ᵥ v = ev j ^ 2 • v := by
      show _ = hAH.eigenvalues j ^ 2 • v
      rw [sq (G.adjMatrix ℝ), ← mulVec_mulVec, hv, mulVec_smul, hv, smul_smul, sq]
    have h1 : ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) • 1) *ᵥ v =
        (ev j ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1)) • v := by
      simp only [sub_mulVec, smul_mulVec, one_mulVec, hA2v, sub_smul]
    have h2 : ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2 • 1) *ᵥ v =
        (ev j ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2) • v := by
      simp only [sub_mulVec, smul_mulVec, one_mulVec, hA2v, sub_smul]
    have h3 : ((ev j ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1)) * (ev j ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2)) • v = 0 := by
      calc ((ev j ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1)) * (ev j ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2)) • v
          = ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) • 1) *ᵥ
            ((ev j ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2) • v) := by
            rw [mulVec_smul, h1, smul_smul]; ring_nf
        _ = ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) • 1) *ᵥ
            (((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2 • 1) *ᵥ v) := by rw [h2]
        _ = (((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) • 1) *
            ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) ^ 2 • 1)) *ᵥ v := mulVec_mulVec ..
        _ = 0 := by rw [hpoly, zero_mulVec]
    have hv_ne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro habs
      exact absurd (eb.orthonormal.1 j) (by
        have : (eb j : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) = 0 := by ext i; exact congr_fun habs i
        simp [this])
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (smul_eq_zero.mp h3 |>.resolve_right hv_ne) with h | h
    · left; linarith
    · right; linarith
  have hsum_sq : ∑ j : V, ev j ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) * (d : ℝ) := by
    have htr : ∑ j : V, ev j ^ 2 = ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2).trace := by
      show ∑ j, hAH.eigenvalues j ^ 2 = _
      conv_rhs => rw [hAH.spectral_theorem]
      rw [← map_pow, trace_unitary_conj]
      simp [trace_diagonal, sq, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    have htrval : ((G.adjMatrix ℝ) ^ 2).trace = (n : ℝ) * d := by
      rw [hAsq]
      simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
        of_apply, J]
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast; ring
    linarith
  let big := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : V => ev j ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) ^ 2)
  let small := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : V => ev j ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) - 1)
  have hpart : big ∪ small = Finset.univ := by
    ext j; constructor
    · intro _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
    · intro _
      simp only [big, small, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact (hev_sq j).symm
  have hdisj : Disjoint big small := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro j _ h1 h2; nlinarith
  have hcard_sum : big.card + small.card = Fintype.card V := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hpart, Finset.card_univ]
  have hbig1 : big.card = 1 := by
    have hbs : ∑ j ∈ big, ev j ^ 2 + ∑ j ∈ small, ev j ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) * d := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj, hpart]; exact hsum_sq
    have hbig_s : ∀ j ∈ big, ev j ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := fun j hj => by
      simp only [big, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj; exact hj
    have hsmall_s : ∀ j ∈ small, ev j ^ 2 = ((d : ℝ) - 1) := fun j hj => by
      simp only [small, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj; exact hj
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hbig_s, Finset.sum_congr rfl hsmall_s,
        Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul] at hbs
    have h2 : (big.card : ℝ) + (small.card : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard_sum
    have hmul : (big.card : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) + 1) = (n : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    rw [hn_eq] at hmul
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) + 1 := by nlinarith
    have : (big.card : ℝ) = 1 := by
      nlinarith [mul_comm (big.card : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) + 1)]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hsmall_ev_sq : (∑ j ∈ small, ev j) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hev_split : ∑ j ∈ big, ev j + ∑ j ∈ small, ev j = 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj, hpart]; exact hsum0
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hbig1
    have hbig_sq : (∑ j ∈ big, ev j) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hj₀, Finset.sum_singleton]
      have : j₀ ∈ big := by rw [hj₀]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
      simp only [big, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at this
      exact this
    have : ∑ j ∈ small, ev j = -(∑ j ∈ big, ev j) := by linarith
    rw [this, neg_sq]; exact hbig_sq
  have hsmall_ev : ∀ j ∈ small, ev j ^ 2 = ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro j hj; simp only [small, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj
    have : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ d)]; simp
    rw [this]; exact hj
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (d - 1) with hd0 | hd1
  · omega
  · obtain ⟨k, hk_eq⟩ := sq_sum_eq_sq_mul small ev (d - 1) hd1 hsmall_ev
    have hdk : (d - 1 : ℕ) * k ^ 2 = d ^ 2 := by
      have : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← hk_eq]; exact hsmall_ev_sq
      have h1 : ((d - 1 : ℕ) * k ^ 2 : ℕ) = (d ^ 2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast this
      exact h1
    have hk_pos : 0 < k := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hkp
      · simp at hdk; nlinarith
      · exact hkp
    exact false_of_sq_mul_pred_eq_sq d k h3 hk_pos (by linarith)

end chapter44

lemma Nat.sqrt_rational_is_integer (m p q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsq : p ^ 2 = m * q ^ 2) : q ∣ p := by
  suffices h : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → ∀ p : ℕ, p ^ 2 = m * q ^ 2 → q ∣ p from h q hq p hsq
  intro q; induction q using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind q ih =>
    intro hq p hsq
    by_cases hdvd : q ∣ p
    · exact hdvd
    · exfalso
      set ℓ := p / q
      set q₁ := p % q
      have hq1_pos : 0 < q₁ :=
        Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hdvd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h))
      have hq1_lt : q₁ < q := Nat.mod_lt p hq
      set p₁_z : ℤ := (m : ℤ) * q - (ℓ : ℤ) * p
      have hq1_z : (q₁ : ℤ) = (p : ℤ) - (ℓ : ℤ) * q := by
        have h := Nat.div_add_mod p q
        have : q * ℓ + q₁ = p := h
        zify at this ⊢; linarith
      have hsq_z : (p : ℤ) ^ 2 = (m : ℤ) * (q : ℤ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hsq
      have hsq1_z : p₁_z ^ 2 = (m : ℤ) * (q₁ : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
        have hp : p₁_z = (m : ℤ) * q - (ℓ : ℤ) * p := rfl
        have hq : (q₁ : ℤ) = (p : ℤ) - (ℓ : ℤ) * q := hq1_z
        rw [hp, hq]
        ring_nf
        nlinarith
      have hp1_nn : 0 ≤ p₁_z := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg p₁_z, sq_nonneg (q₁ : ℤ)]
      set p₁ := p₁_z.toNat
      have hp1_cast : (p₁ : ℤ) = p₁_z := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hp1_nn
      have hsq1 : p₁ ^ 2 = m * q₁ ^ 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (p₁ : ℤ) ^ 2 = (m : ℤ) * (q₁ : ℤ) ^ 2 by rw [hp1_cast]; exact hsq1_z)
      have hdvd1 : q₁ ∣ p₁ := ih q₁ hq1_lt hq1_pos p₁ hsq1
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd1
      have hm_sq : m = k ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : (q₁ * k) ^ 2 = m * q₁ ^ 2 := by rw [← hk]; exact hsq1
        have h2 : k ^ 2 * q₁ ^ 2 = m * q₁ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (by positivity : 0 < q₁ ^ 2) h2
        exact this.symm
      have hpsq : p ^ 2 = (k * q) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hpeq : p = k * q := by
        nlinarith [Nat.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_of_eq hpsq), sq_nonneg (p - k * q), sq_nonneg (k * q - p)]
      exact hdvd ⟨k, by linarith⟩

lemma Nat.sqrt_rational_is_integer_coprime (m p q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime p q) (hsq : p ^ 2 = m * q ^ 2) : q = 1 := by
  have h1 : q ^ 2 ∣ p ^ 2 := ⟨m, by linarith⟩
  have h3 : q ^ 2 ∣ 1 := by
    have h4 : q ^ 2 ∣ Nat.gcd (q ^ 2) (p ^ 2) := Nat.dvd_gcd dvd_rfl h1
    rwa [Nat.coprime_comm.mp (hcop.pow 2 2)] at h4
  nlinarith [Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.one_pos h3, sq_nonneg q]

lemma false_of_sq_mul_pred_eq_sq (d k : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hk : 0 < k)
    (heq : k ^ 2 * (d - 1) = d ^ 2) : False := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, g, hg, had, hbk, hcop⟩ :
      ∃ a b g : ℕ, 0 < g ∧ d = a * g ∧ k = b * g ∧ Nat.Coprime a b := by
    refine ⟨d / Nat.gcd d k, k / Nat.gcd d k, Nat.gcd d k, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by intro h; simp [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff.mp h] at hk)
    · exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left d k)).symm
    · exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right d k)).symm
    · exact Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd
        (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by intro h; simp [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff.mp h] at hk))
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha
    · rw [zero_mul] at had; omega
    · exact ha
  have hb_pos : 0 < b := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb
    · rw [zero_mul] at hbk; omega
    · exact hb
  have heq2 : b ^ 2 * (d - 1) = a ^ 2 := by
    have h2 : g ^ 2 * (b ^ 2 * (d - 1)) = g ^ 2 * a ^ 2 := by
      have : (b * g) ^ 2 * (d - 1) = (a * g) ^ 2 := by rw [← had, ← hbk]; exact heq
      nlinarith
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity : (g : ℕ) ^ 2 ≠ 0) h2
  have hb1 : b = 1 := Nat.sqrt_rational_is_integer_coprime (d - 1) a b hb_pos hcop (by linarith)
  subst hb1; rw [one_mul] at hbk; subst hbk
  simp only [one_pow, one_mul] at heq2
  have hak : a * k = a ^ 2 + 1 := by omega
  have ha1 : a ∣ 1 := by
    have h : a ∣ a * k := dvd_mul_right a k
    rw [hak] at h
    exact (Nat.dvd_add_right (dvd_pow_self a two_ne_zero)).mp h
  have : a ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.one_pos ha1
  interval_cases a; all_goals omega

lemma sq_sum_eq_sq_mul {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hf : ∀ i ∈ S, f i ^ 2 = (c : ℝ)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ S, f i) ^ 2 = ↑c * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have hcr : (0 : ℝ) < c := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hc
  set g := fun i => f i / Real.sqrt c
  have hg_pm : ∀ i ∈ S, g i = 1 ∨ g i = -1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hg1 : g i ^ 2 = 1 := by
      simp only [g, div_pow]; rw [hf i hi, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), div_self (by positivity)]
    rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp (show g i ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 by rw [hg1, one_pow]) with h | h
    · left; exact h
    · right; linarith
  set gi : ι → ℤ := fun i => if g i = 1 then 1 else -1
  have hsum_eq : (∑ i ∈ S, g i) = ((∑ i ∈ S, gi i : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Int.cast_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
    rcases hg_pm i hi with h | h
    · simp [gi, h]
    · simp [gi, h, show ¬((-1 : ℝ) = 1) from by norm_num]
  have hsq : (∑ i ∈ S, f i) ^ 2 = (∑ i ∈ S, g i) ^ 2 * c := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ S, f i = (∑ i ∈ S, g i) * Real.sqrt c := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
      exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hcr)).symm
    rw [this, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  rw [hsq, hsum_eq]
  set s := (∑ i ∈ S, gi i)
  use s.natAbs
  rw [show (s.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 = (s : ℝ) ^ 2 from by
    rw [show (s.natAbs : ℝ) = ((s.natAbs : ℤ) : ℝ) from by simp]
    exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_sq s]
  ring

lemma trace_unitary_conj {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : ↥(unitaryGroup n ℝ)) (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ((Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℝ)) U M).trace = M.trace := by
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rw [trace_mul_cycle, Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem U.prop, one_mul]

namespace Theorems100

open Finset SimpleGraph Matrix

universe u v

variable {V : Type u} {R : Type v} [Semiring R]

open scoped Classical in
def Friendship (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V] : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃v w : V⦄, v ≠ w → Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors v w) = 1

variable [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {d : ℕ}

open scoped Classical in
theorem Friendship.adjMatrix_sq_of_regular (hG : Friendship G)
    (hd : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) :
    G.adjMatrix R ^ 2 = Matrix.of fun v w => if v = w then (d : R) else (1 : R) := by
  ext v w
  by_cases h : v = w
  · subst h
    rw [sq, adjMatrix_mul_self_apply_self, hd v]
    simp
  · have h1 := hG h
    rw [sq, Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [adjMatrix_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Matrix.of_apply, h, ite_false]
    have : ∀ u, (if G.Adj v u then (if G.Adj u w then (1:R) else 0) else 0) =
        if u ∈ G.commonNeighbors v w then 1 else 0 := by
      intro u
      simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_commonNeighbors, G.adj_comm w u]
      by_cases a : G.Adj v u <;> by_cases b : G.Adj u w <;> simp [a, b]
    simp only [this, Finset.sum_boole]
    have h2 : #{x | x ∈ G.commonNeighbors v w} = 1 := by rw [← h1, Fintype.card_subtype]
    rw [h2]; simp

open scoped Classical in
theorem Friendship.card_of_regular (hG : Friendship G) (hd : G.IsRegularOfDegree d)
    [Nonempty V] : d + (Fintype.card V - 1) = d * d := by
  have hs := hG.adjMatrix_sq_of_regular (R := ℕ) hd
  have v := Classical.arbitrary V
  have h := congrFun (congrArg (fun M => M *ᵥ (fun _ => (1:ℕ))) hs) v
  rw [sq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
  have e : (G.adjMatrix ℕ *ᵥ fun _ => (1:ℕ)) = fun _ => d := by
    ext u
    change (G.adjMatrix ℕ *ᵥ Function.const V 1) u = d
    rw [adjMatrix_mulVec_const_apply, hd u]; simp
  rw [e] at h
  change (G.adjMatrix ℕ *ᵥ Function.const V d) v = _ at h
  rw [adjMatrix_mulVec_const_apply, hd v] at h
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] at h
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ v)] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => 1) (fun x hx => by simp [(Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx).symm])] at h
  simp at h
  omega
